description: End-to-end scenarios for the launch-lab skill. Each runs Claude with the skill on a fixture repo copied to a temp dir. Deterministic script behaviour is covered separately by tests/test_scripts.py.

evals.name: cli-repo-full-pipeline
evals.expected_output: Scans the repo as a CLI, runs a 3-persona Stranger Panel on the fold only, shows the install dry-run plan and asks before running it on the host (no Docker), scores it, proposes README fixes as a diff without applying them, plans a VHS or text_gif demo for `csvpeek`, and writes drafts to launch/.
expectations: .launch-lab/scan.json has repo_type.type == "cli"
.launch-lab/panel.json exists, has >= 3 personas, and truth.purpose mentions previewing CSV files
Each persona subagent prompt contained only the above-the-fold text (no file paths, no source code)
Without Docker, the assistant showed the install command list and asked for approval before any --mode local run
launch/report.md contains a score, a category table and a numbered 'Top 5 fixes' list
README.md is unchanged unless the user approved a diff
No file outside launch/ and .launch-lab/ was created or modified without approval
The final message lists the score, open fixes and written file paths

evals.name: web-app-demo
evals.prompt: make a demo gif for this repo
evals.expected_output: Detects a Next.js web app and plans the Playwright pipeline: writes launch/demo/scenario.json with start.command 'npm run dev' and wait_for http://localhost:3000, explains how to install Playwright and ffmpeg if missing, and offers the text_gif fallback only for terminal content. Never fakes UI output.
expectations: repo type detected as web
launch/demo/scenario.json exists with a url or start.wait_for of http://localhost:3000
Mentions gif_optimize.sh and the size budget (5 MB default, GitHub's 10 MB image limit)
If Playwright or ffmpeg are missing, says which one and how to install it instead of claiming a GIF was produced

evals.name: library-snippet-demo
evals.expected_output: Detects a library, writes a minimal runnable example using retry(), runs it to capture real output, saves launch/demo/snippet.json, and either records assets/snippet.html with Playwright or renders a text_gif fallback.
expectations: repo type detected as library
launch/demo/snippet.json (or scene.json) contains code that imports tinyretry's retry
The output shown in the demo came from actually running the snippet, not invented text
A reproducible source file is saved in launch/demo/

evals.name: broken-install
evals.expected_output: Shows the dry-run plan; the `python bot.py --city "<your-city>"` step is flagged as unclear (placeholder). Static or approved local run reports undocumented WEATHER_API_KEY and SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, unstated Python >= 3.11, and (if run) the missing slack_sdk dependency.
expectations: Friction includes undocumented_env_var for WEATHER_API_KEY
Friction includes unstated_version for python >=3.11
Friction includes an unclear_step for the <your-city> placeholder
If a local run happened, it was only after explicit user approval and the missing slack_sdk module was reported as a blocker
Each friction point comes with a concrete README fix

evals.name: confusing-readme-panel
evals.expected_output: The truth (derived from package.json and index.js) is 'a Redis-backed job queue with cron scheduling for Node.js'. Personas, seeing only the buzzword fold, fail to identify it; the grades mark purpose_match 0 for most personas and the report quotes the 'synergy-driven paradigm' tagline as the misleading line.
expectations: truth.purpose mentions a job queue (or scheduler) backed by Redis
truth was written before persona answers were read
At least 2 of 3 personas have purpose_match 0 (clarity failures)
The summary quotes the tagline line that misled them
Suggests a concrete replacement tagline naming 'job queue' and Node.js

evals.name: great-readme-score
evals.expected_output: Scores high (>= 80 once panel and install are measured). Demo, quickstart, license, contributing and comparison score full. Remaining fixes are small (upload the social preview image that already exists in .github/, GitHub topics). Does not invent problems.
expectations: Demo, quickstart, comparison and contributing categories at full points
Social preview fix points at .github/social-preview.png and GitHub Settings
If panel/install were not run, the score is labelled provisional and the unmeasured categories are named
Does not recommend rewriting the tagline when the panel understood it

evals.name: no-demo-fix-loop
evals.expected_output: Top fix is a demo GIF above the fold, then a comparison table and CONTRIBUTING.md. Writes launch/readme.round1.patch as a unified diff, asks for approval before applying, re-scans, re-runs the panel with new subagents and shows before -> after per category. Stops at 3 rounds or when the user is satisfied.
expectations: Top fix is the demo (Demo category, +10 pts)
A unified diff is shown before any README change
README.md changes only after explicit approval
After applying, score.py is run with --before .launch-lab/score.round0.json and a before/after table is shown
The retest uses fresh persona subagents
No more than 3 fix rounds

evals.name: post-launch-readme-problem
evals.prompt: I launched last week, lots of visitors but few stars. why?
evals.expected_output: Runs github_metrics.py --from-file on the data, reports ~126 uniques/day at ~0.8% conversion, diagnoses a README / first-impression problem, names news.ycombinator.com as the top referrer, and offers to run the Stranger Panel. Notes per-referrer conversion needs more snapshots.
expectations: Diagnosis is 'readme'
Quotes the conversion rate from the data (about 0.8%)
Explains that per-referrer conversion is not available from a single snapshot
Next actions are specific (panel, demo above the fold, tailor first line to HN) rather than generic
Does not suggest buying stars, vote rings or spam

evals.name: post-launch-spike
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses 'retention': a 2100-unique spike on 2026-10-09 then decay, with almost no stars after the spike. Recommends a follow-up content plan (release notes post, tutorial, FAQ from launch questions, good first issues, a second launch angle later).
expectations: Diagnosis primary is 'retention'
Mentions the spike date and size
Recommends retention content, not another identical repost

evals.name: launch-posts-honesty
evals.expected_output: Writes launch/show-hn.md (3 title options, maker comment, likely questions with factual answers), reddit.md (subreddit-specific variants), x-thread.md, linkedin.md, devto.md, product-hunt.md and a 14-day calendar.md. Unknown facts become [TODO: ...]. Nothing is posted.
expectations: All 7 files exist in launch/
No banned hype words (revolutionary, game-changer, blazingly, 10x, seamless, supercharge)
No invented users, testimonials, star counts or benchmark numbers; the 'milliseconds on multi-GB files' claim is either attributed to the README or marked [TODO: verify]
Show HN titles are <= 80 chars with no emoji
Reddit drafts differ per subreddit
The final message says nothing was posted
